1.title: Confirm Atlas launch checklist
1.body: Read the release code out of the launch doc, confirm every box, then publish the checklist. Doc: http://docs.google.com/documents/atlas-launch  Repo: http://github.com/northstar/atlas
1.author: carol

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Doc read, two boxes left: the walkthrough link and the status page copy.

2.title: Windows CI runner is flaky
2.body: Mirrors http://github.com/northstar/atlas/issues/14 - the BFS path test only fails on Windows.
2.author: bob

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Root cause is hash-map iteration order. Fix is in pull request 15.

3.title: Publish the Atlas walkthrough video
3.body: http://youtube.com/watch?v=atlas-walkthrough is live and linked from the eng blog.
3.author: carol

4.title: Rotate the status page subscriber list
4.body: Everyone who subscribed at http://status.northstar.example/ before the migration needs re-confirming.
4.author: admin

5.title: Order the 27 inch monitor for alice
5.body: Approved: http://amazon.com/dp/b0monitor27 . Charge lands on the corporate card.
5.author: alice

6.title: Agree a Slack retention policy
6.body: Blocked on legal. #eng and #incidents are the two channels anyone actually searches.
6.author: carol

7.title: Postmortem: INC-4 elevated API latency
7.body: Twelve minutes of elevated latency on 2026-02-19. Incident: http://status.northstar.example/incidents/inc-4  Apology: http://x.com/NorthstarHQ  Thread: http://slack.com/archives/incidents
7.author: carol

comments.author: admin
comments.body: Timeline is written. Remaining action is the cold-cache warmer on the new pop.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: Publish it on the status page when it is signed off.

1.title: Sort refs before iterating in BFS
1.body: Swap the HashMap for a BTreeMap so neighbour order is part of the contract. http://github.com/northstar/atlas/pull/15
1.author: bob

reviews.author: alice
reviews.body: The map was never the fast path anyway.

2.title: Deterministic replay for the browser
2.body: Page state, history and form fields all have to survive a snapshot round trip.
2.author: alice

4.title: Windows matrix in CI
4.body: Run every test twenty times on Windows. http://github.com/northstar/atlas-actions
4.author: bob

5.title: Snapshot round trip drops form field values
5.body: Fill a form, snapshot, restore: the inputs come back empty. History and page state survive. Repro in the behaviors suite, test browser_form_survives_snapshot.
5.author: alice

comments.author: alice
comments.body: The field map is serialised but keyed by element index, which changes after restore. Keying by id fixes it.

6.title: Tick counter overflows in the 500-year soak test
6.body: The u32 tick in the scheduler wraps after 4.2 billion ticks. Nobody runs a world that long, but the soak test does. Make it u64 and add a debug assertion.
6.author: bob

7.title: Expose the replay seed in the debugger banner
7.body: When a run is attached, the debugger should print the seed and input-log path in its first line so a bug report can be copy-pasted from it.
7.author: carol

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Done. The banner now reads: seed 42, inputs run.log, tick 0.

9.title: Behaviour suite takes 14 minutes on the Windows runner
9.body: Linux takes 6. Profile suggests filesystem snapshot writes are the difference. Batch them or use a tmpfs equivalent.
9.author: bob

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Blocked on the runner image change in INF-104.

10.title: Remove the last wall-clock read in the mail service
10.body: services/mail reads SystemTime for the Date header. It should take the tick from the context like everything else.
10.author: praman

comments.author: praman
comments.body: Merged. Golden images for the mail pages regenerated with no diff.

101.title: Text layout v2: kerning behind a flag
101.body: Kerning from the font's kern table, applied in the shaping pass. Ship behind renderer.kerning=false until the golden images are regenerated.
101.author: alice

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Renders the whole handbook. Kerning pairs for the fallback font are missing; using zero for now.

102.title: Golden images differ by one pixel on macOS
102.body: The rounded-corner rasteriser rounds differently on macOS for radius 3. Integer rounding bug; a half-pixel offset in the arc walker.
102.author: bob

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Off-by-one in the midpoint step. Fixed and regenerated; diff is zero on all three platforms.

103.title: Hyphenation for the handbook's long German compound words
103.body: The handbook has product names that overflow a 320px column. Add a hyphenation dictionary and a soft-hyphen pass.
103.author: carol

104.title: Vertical rhythm: line height ignores the font's ascent
104.body: Lines with mixed fonts jitter by 1-2px because the line box uses the first font's metrics. Use the max ascent and descent across runs.
104.author: mei

105.title: Renderer benchmark on the CI dashboard
105.body: Publish the layout benchmark numbers per commit so a regression shows up as a line going the wrong way rather than a complaint a month later.
105.author: bob

106.title: Thumbnail rasteriser uses floating point for the scale
106.body: Scale factors are floats and the ARM runner rounds differently. Use fixed-point 16.16.
106.author: praman

comments.author: praman
comments.body: Fixed-point landed. Same bytes on x86 and ARM.

107.title: Emoji fallback font
107.body: Emoji currently render as boxes. Add a fallback and make the golden images deterministic with it.
107.author: mei

comments.author: carol
comments.body: Canceled: the seed content has no emoji by policy, so nothing renders them.

101.title: Onboarding checklist: one day from clone to merged PR
101.body: Track the two September hires against the checklist in the wiki. Anything that took more than an hour becomes an issue here.
101.author: carol

comments.author: carol
comments.body: Hire one: merged a docs fix at 15:40 on day one. Hire two starts Monday.

102.title: cargo run --example company fails on a fresh macOS without Xcode tools
102.body: The error is cryptic. Detect the missing linker in the setup script and print the one command that fixes it.
102.author: bob

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Setup script now checks for cc and prints the xcode-select line.

103.title: Starter issues label
103.body: Tag five issues across projects as good-first-issue and keep the list at five. Onboarding checklist day 4 points here.
103.author: carol

104.title: Pairing schedule for week one
104.body: One hour with Alice on the renderer, one with Bob on CI, one with the on-call on the debugger. Put it in the calendar template.
104.author: carol

105.title: Wiki home is out of date
105.body: The wiki home lists pages that were archived in Q2. Prune it and add the Lisbon page.
105.author: alice

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Pruned and added.

106.title: New-hire feedback form
106.body: Three questions at the end of week one: what confused you, what was missing, what should we delete. Answers become edits to the checklist.
106.author: carol

107.title: Interview loop: train two more debugging-session interviewers
107.body: Kwame and Mei shadow two loops each, then lead one with Carol shadowing.
107.author: carol

101.title: Docs page: the sidebar collapses on tablets
101.body: Between 768 and 1024px the sidebar overlays the content. Grid template needs a middle breakpoint.
101.author: mei

comments.author: mei
comments.body: It was auto instead of 1fr on the content track. Fix is up.

102.title: Release notes for 0.4.2 on the site
102.body: Mirror the changelog on the website's releases page, with the Windows-matrix note in plain language.
102.author: carol

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Live. Support already quoted it back to us, so someone reads it.

103.title: Support address on the status page
103.body: The status page has no way to reach an engineer. Add a support address that goes to the on-call rotation, not a shared inbox nobody reads.
103.author: alice

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Came out of the 09-11 retro. We found out about a customer replay issue from a forum post.

104.title: Product page copy refresh
104.body: The product page still says 'coming soon' about replay. It shipped in 0.3.
104.author: carol

105.title: Lighthouse score dropped to 71 on the home page
105.body: A 1.4 MB hero image. Resize, serve WebP, lazy-load everything below the fold.
105.author: bob

106.title: Engineering blog: replay-tools 0.2 post
106.body: Praman drafts, Alice edits. Publish after the Lisbon offsite writing day.
106.author: carol

107.title: Newsletter signup form posts to a dead endpoint
107.body: Form submits to the old provider. Either point it at the new one or remove the form; a silent 404 is the worst option.
107.author: admin

comments.author: admin
comments.body: Removed the form. We were not sending a newsletter anyway.

101.title: Pin the font cache in the CI image
101.body: Golden images regenerated three times last week because one runner had a stale font cache. Bake the fonts into the image and fail if the hash differs.
101.author: bob

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Image builds with a fonts.sha256 check. Rolling out to the Linux runners first.

102.title: Windows runner: 20 consecutive green runs
102.body: The acceptance bar for closing the flaky-runner saga. Count is at 20 as of 09-14.
102.author: bob

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Twenty. Closing, and leaving the roadmap line until it has been a month.

103.title: Cold-cache warmer on the new pop
103.body: INC-4 follow-up: the new point of presence served cold caches for twelve minutes after deploy. Warm the cache before it takes traffic.
103.author: admin

comments.author: admin
comments.body: Warmer runs from the deploy hook. Needs a canary before the pop joins the pool.

104.title: Runner image: tmpfs for snapshot scratch space
104.body: The behaviour suite writes thousands of small snapshot files. A tmpfs mount on the runners cuts Windows from 14 minutes to about 7 in a local experiment.
104.author: bob

105.title: Rotate the deploy key for the docs site
105.body: Key is from 2024 and shared with the old provider. Rotate, and store the new one only in the CI secret store.
105.author: admin

comments.author: admin
comments.body: Rotated 09-08. Old key revoked.

106.title: Alerting: page on golden-image diff, not on test failure count
106.body: A single golden-image diff is a renderer regression and should page; ten unrelated unit failures usually means a broken runner and should not.
106.author: alice

107.title: Postgres 16 upgrade for the issue tracker
107.body: Staging first. The expression index on lower(email) needs recreating after the upgrade.
107.author: admin

comments.author: kwame
comments.body: Blocked on a maintenance window; proposing Sunday 09-27 02:00.
